## Tribal Protector (CR 4)

**XP** 1,200  
 Male awakened leopard  
 NG Medium magical beast (augmented animal)  
 **Init** +4; **Senses** scent; Perception +5  

**Defense**

 **AC** 15, touch 14, flat-footed 11 (+4 Dex, +1 natural)  
 **hp** 50 (5d8+10)  
 **Fort** +6, **Ref** +8, **Will** +2  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 30 ft., climb 20 ft.  
 **Melee** bite +7 (1d6+4 plus grab), 2 claws +7 (1d3+4)  
 **Special Attacks** pounce, rake (2 claws +7, 1d3+3)  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 16, **Dex** 19, **Con** 15, **Int** 12, **Wis** 13, **Cha** 8  
 **Base Atk** +3; **CMB** +7 (+11 grapple); **CMD** 20 (24 vs. trip)  
 **Feats** Combat Reflexes, Skill Focus (Stealth), Weapon Finesse  
*House rules: Weapon Finesse adds Dex instead of Str to finesse damage and CMB.*  
 **Skills** Acrobatics +8, Climb +15, Diplomacy +4, Perception +5, Stealth +11 (+15 in undergrowth), Survival +6, Swim +7; **Racial Modifiers** +4 on Stealth in undergrowth  
 **Languages** Common, Polyglot  

**Background**
